name: World geography
description: Places, landscapes, and the connections that shape our world.

questions.prompt: What is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.explanation: The Pacific covers more area than all of Earth's land combined.

questions.prompt: What is the tallest mountain above sea level?
questions.explanation: It stands about 8,849 m (29,032 ft) high.

questions.prompt: Which river is usually listed as the longest in the world?
questions.explanation: Some studies argue the Amazon is longer; the answer depends on how the source is measured.

questions.prompt: What is the smallest country in the world by area?
questions.explanation: Vatican City covers less than half a square kilometer, about a fifth of a square mile.

questions.prompt: What is the largest country in the world by area?
questions.explanation: Russia covers about 17 million km², more than a ninth of Earth's land.

questions.prompt: Which country has had the largest population since 2023?
questions.explanation: UN estimates show India passing China in 2023.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.explanation: Canberra was built as the capital as a compromise between rivals Sydney and Melbourne.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Canada?
questions.explanation: Ottawa, not Toronto, is the capital. Queen Victoria chose it in 1857.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Brazil?
questions.explanation: Brasília replaced Rio de Janeiro as the capital in 1960.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Turkey?
questions.explanation: Ankara replaced Istanbul as the capital in 1923, when the Republic of Turkey was founded.
